headline: SDP @ BAL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SDP 3.61 at BAL 4.53, with a projected total of 8.14. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BAL: SDP moved -0.42 runs while BAL moved +0.41, changing the projected margin by -0.83 runs. NRFI probability rose +12.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Shane Baz has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Pete Alonso, Taylor Ward, Fernando Tatis Jr., based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Samuel Basallo, Gavin Sheets because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
